You each have this series of events play out over and over... a redcoat walks up to you, his mouth turns into a gaping maw.  Roaches crawl from empty eye sockets.  His skin bubbling as if boiling water.  As he breathes in, you feel as if 1 layer of your mind has been removed.  You are certain that he must have took something, but no matter how hard you try, what you thought was there seems missing, but everything you remember is still there.  What did he eat.  When his maw closes, he begins to walk away, before he turns around, and walks up to you, his mouth turns into a gaping maw.... 

How many times did you live that?  How much time has passed?  Will you ever escape? Wait... was it hope he stole.... or are you just feeling hopeless?  who knows?

Sincerely
